subject: Helix Health MSA / Security exhibit — redlines + evidence cadence
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: security@helixhealth.com, procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Security exhibit questions and timing

Hi Priyom / Laura —

Thanks for sending the draft MSA and Order Form last night. Legal had a look and returned a handful of security exhibit redlines that we need to resolve before our procurement team can issue the PO. The key asks are:

- Confirmation of SOC 2 Type II report availability and date range (they asked for most recent 12 months).
- Penetration test window expectations + whether Redwood will permit a customer-led pen test under NDA, and what controls exist for staging access.
- Audit rights language — Helix is requesting a right to inspect (sampled) once per 12 months, with evidence handoff cadence and an SLA for Redwood responses to evidence requests.

We need to capture: (a) what artifacts Redwood will provide as evidence, (b) the expected response times, and (c) a proposed schedule so procurement can align PO timing.

Can you confirm what we can share and propose an evidence cadence? If it helps, I can share Helix's redlines as a Word doc.

Thanks,
Sara
Sr. Contracts Manager
Helix Health

--
Attachment: helix_redlines_security_exhibit.docx (referenced, not included)

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit questions and timing

Sara —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick answers up front and then an action grid below.

High-level: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II report for the last completed 12-month period (we'll attach the 2024 report). For pen tests we support both vendor-conducted pen tests and customer-led tests in our staging environment under an NDA; we have a standard staging access playbook and a typical 2-week maintenance window request for scheduling.

Audit rights: Redwood's standard security exhibit allows for annual inspections on a sampled basis with a formal evidence request process. We can commit to an evidence response SLA of 5 business days for standard items, and 10 business days for items that require engineering support or logs. For anything that requires system-level access we provide sanitized exports or controlled staging sessions — we do not provide access to production credentials.

Action grid (owners / ETA):
1) Share SOC 2 Type II (2024) — owner: Priyom — ETA: today (attachment).
2) Draft proposed answers to Helix redlines and markups to exhibit — owner: Laura (Legal) — ETA: 24-48h.
3) Define pen-test staging window and checklist for customer-led tests — owner: Karthik (Infra) — ETA: 2 business days.
4) Create a short evidence cadence spreadsheet (what we can share / expected format / SLA) — owner: Priyom — ETA: today.

If that works I will route Laura's marked exhibit back with inline comments and a brief cover email we can send to Sara / procurement.

Best,
Priyom Das
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood_soc2_report_2024.pdf (stub)

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit questions and timing

Sara / Priyom —

Thanks — I reviewed Helix's redlines and prepared a marked version of the security exhibit with two tracks: a conservative legal position and a pragmatic commercial position that narrows the customer's inspection right to "sampled review once per 12 months with 7 days' notice" and an evidence SLA of 5 business days for standard artifacts.

Key proposed language (commercial track) — examples: 
- Audit Rights: "Customer may request an on-site or remote inspection of operational controls on an annual sampled basis. Redwood will respond to evidence requests for standard artifacts within 5 business days; requests requiring engineering assistance will be triaged and responded to within 10 business days."
- Penetration testing: "Customer-led penetration tests are permitted in designated staging environments under ANC NDA; Redwood will provide a staging access checklist and required test windows must be scheduled at least 10 business days in advance."

I attached the marked exhibit and an evidence-cadence sample workbook enumerating common artifacts (SOC 2 report, control narratives, configuration exports, vulnerability scan summary, redacted access logs). Please confirm whether Helix needs any additional item types.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: proposed-security-exhibit-redlines.docx (stub)
Attachment: evidence-cadence-sample.xlsx (stub)

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helixhealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com, security@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jul 2025 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit questions and timing

Laura —

This is helpful. Procurement reviewed the commercial track and asked for two clarifications before they can sign off: (1) an explicit list of artifacts we will provide on request (they want it in the exhibit or an appended schedule), and (2) whether Redwood will commit to a maximum of two evidence requests per 12-month period (they want to avoid open-ended evidence churn).

From security's side: OK with staged customer-led testing provided we have a test plan template and a 2-week booking window. Could you add the test plan template to the workbook?

If you can update the exhibit to include an artifacts schedule and a clause limiting routine evidence requests to two per year (with exceptions allowed for incidents or regulator requests), we can move to procurement PO and then DocuSign for the Order Form.

Thanks — I can reconvene procurement/ops for a quick call if helpful.

Sara

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@helixhealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Jul 2025 16:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Security exhibit questions and timing

Sara —

We can do that. Quick confirmations from engineering infra:
- We'll add a short artifacts schedule listing SOC 2 Type II report (2024), control matrix CSV, vulnerability scan summary (monthly), sanitized configuration export for staging, and a redacted request log sample.
- Two routine evidence requests per 12 months is workable for standard artifacts — for anything outside the schedule (e.g., deep-forensic logs) we'll route via legal and treat as an exception (incident/regulatory).
- Pen test: I'll attach a 1-page test-plan template and the staging booking checklist. Staging access will be for a maximum 48-hour window per test unless otherwise agreed.

Next steps: Laura will push an updated security exhibit with the artifacts schedule and the two-request limit; Priyom will send the DocuSign Order Form link once legal signs off on the final exhibit.

Karthik Iyer
Infra Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference
